description: This file implements the GatekeeperResponder class, which processes messages received over a channel, deserializes requests, invokes corresponding methods on a GateKeeper object, and sends responses. It handles 'ENROLL' and 'VERIFY' commands and logs errors for unrecognized messages or deserialization failures.

classes.name: GatekeeperResponder
classes.description: A class responsible for handling incoming messages, deserializing requests, invoking gatekeeper methods, and sending responses.

methods.name: GatekeeperResponder::ProcessMessage
methods.description: Processes a message received on the channel, handles 'ENROLL' and 'VERIFY' commands, and returns success status.
